path_parameters.name: application_id
path_parameters.description: Application namespace within the authenticated tenant. Application principals may target only their own application; tenant-wide principals may target any application in their tenant.

path_parameters.name: group_name
path_parameters.description: Validated logical notification group such as account, social, banking, ecommerce, delivery, or a custom lowercase slug.

path_parameters.name: recipient_identifier
path_parameters.description: Tenant-local user identifier that owns the notification feed.
